sources.entry: Keytty - App to keep your hands on the keyboard. Move, click, scroll, drag and more with a few strokes.

summary.name: Keytty
summary.one_liner: Keytty is a macOS app that lets you control the mouse cursor (move, click, scroll, drag) from the keyboard.
use_cases: Moving the mouse cursor without reaching for a mouse or trackpad
Clicking, double-clicking and right-clicking from the keyboard
Scrolling and dragging and dropping with keys
Jumping the cursor between multiple monitors
Keeping hands on the keyboard during long coding or writing sessions
summary.what_it_does: Keytty runs as a macOS app. Pressing Command twice quickly opens its interface, after which single-key commands control the cursor. Simple moves use H/J/K/L or the arrow keys, and section moves jump to center or corners (C, W, E, S, D). A manual mode takes a number for distance. An action mode (triggered by typing A) provides left, right and double click, scroll up/down/left/right, and drag start and drop. The spacebar jumps the cursor to the next screen on multi-monitor setups.
notable: Press Command twice quickly to open the control interface
Vim-style H/J/K/L movement plus arrow keys
Spacebar jumps the cursor between screens on multiple monitors
Modal action mode (type A) for clicks, scrolling and drag and drop
caveats: Not intended to replace a mouse or trackpad
Cannot override OS-level controls such as Mission Control, Launchpad or the login screen
